meta.title: Who Will Ask the Questions?
meta.textType: story: a team talk about who asks and who writes

paragraphs: At lunchtime on Monday, January eighteenth, the four friends sat at a table in the school library. Lily, Mia, Leo, and May were members of the Explorers club. Their lunch boxes were open on the table. Teacher Kim came to the table with a clipboard and a sheet of paper. The sheet said "MARKET PAIRS" at the top. It had two lines, "Asks" and "Writes." "On Saturday, January twenty-third, our group will go to the market," said Teacher Kim. "Each pair needs one child to ask the questions and one child to write the answers." "You are four, so please make two pairs." "It is important to decide today, so please discuss it together." Then she went to help the next table.

"Who should ask the questions?" asked Mia. "I think that Leo should ask, because he is never shy," she said. Leo put up both hands and smiled. "I know that I am a good talker," he said. "I will be friendly to every seller." May listened with her pencil in her hand. Then she shook her head. "I don't agree," she said. "Leo is funny, but he is not serious." "I think that May is smart, and she likes asking questions," said Lily.

"Let us make two pairs," said Lily. "May asks, and I write, because we work well together." "And who will write for me?" asked Leo. "I will be your partner," said Mia. "I like writing, but I am shy with strangers." "Do you mind writing for a talker like me?" asked Leo. "I don't mind," said Mia, and she smiled. The friends wrote the names on the sheet and held up their thumbs. Teacher Kim came back and read the sheet. She wrote a note on her clipboard.

"I am sure that you will be a good team," she said. "I hope that you will ask kind questions and write clear answers." "Please ask each seller for a name, and be friendly." "A seller is busy, so ask only a few questions." "What will you ask first?" "I will ask about the best food," said May.

"Let's meet at the fruit stall at ten o'clock," said Leo. Everybody agreed. The lunch break was nearly over. May put the sheet in her notebook. Mia was not afraid now, because she had a good partner. Lily looked at the sheet and smiled.
